verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe escalation policies with multi-step targets, time delays, round robin, and fallback to ensure alerts get acknowledged and acted on (rootly-docs-39), plus the general definition of escalation policies determining notification steps and what happens if unacknowledged (rootly-docs-7). There's a community comment skeptical that Rootly's on-call solves 'hard problems' (rootly-comm-7), but this is general skepticism, not a concrete failure of escalation mechanics, so it doesn't dispute the documented capability. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that repeat escalation rounds and fallback responders work in practice beyond docs.
